name: steward-charter
principles: Scripts measure, bounded model calls judge, the coder writes inside an approved spec.
Every change is a pack version; the previous version is the rollback.
The Steward never touches the lanes and places that govern it.
notes: goal ships as REPLACE ME: the Steward asks for it first. scope empty = only the nets this pack created. autonomyLevel 1 observe only, 2 propose only, 3 apply with approval, 4 tune and view alone, 5 also crystallise alone. The coder edits packDir inside a clone of repoUrl under home.
